name: Log1p Bank bounded optimized accuracy-cost comparison v1
classification: Exploratory expanded search after previous fixed-configuration outcomes; independent validation within new frozen search
geometry: Same full posterior-Hessian inverse, prior-scaled1e-10 ridge; CV2 correction uses unregularized likelihood Hessian

pilot.refinement: Per(method,n): if no full-horizon stable base h, add h_min/4 and h_min/16. Otherwise first add geometric midpoint at highest stable-to-failed adjacent boundary if any; if largest h stable add2*h_max. Fill remaining slots with geometric midpoints of adjacent base h, ranked by number of endpoints contributing within-batch nondominated warm/cold/SW2/variance points, then lower h. Maximum2 extra h each, same rule for both methods. No more rounds.

selection.rule: Across stable pilot configs: rank all checkpoint points by 4D non-domination (warm,cold,SW2,variance). Per batch choose configs covering most global first-front points; ties best global front rank, within-batch first-front count, higher inverse-rank checkpoint coverage, then h. Preserve at least one stable config per batch; max2. Candidates frozen before validation.

validation.extension_trigger: Uniform4096 for all selected CV1/CV2 configs if any selected stable pilot config has worse-reference mean variance_NRMSE at2048>.20 and falls at least10% from1024. Otherwise2048. No further extension or selection after validation.

metrics: Existing endpoint standardized slicedW2 and relative per-replica ergodic variance NRMSE; per-reference mean over seeds then worse reference. Fixed approved scoring clouds/projections.
failure_rule: Any failed replica or incomplete run in any seed invalidates complete n,h config at every checkpoint over its phase-specific tested horizon. Never delete failures or score survivors. Original radius limit100sqrt(d).
reference: Reuse approved log1p two-pool reference, all individual and pair frozen gates verified before start; no new target/ref construction.
cost: Warm=stored locally measured mode fit attribution + actual current prepare/state setup + synchronized sampler/RNG. Cold adds actual shape-specific compile attribution, excludes warmup. Reference,scoring,functionals,storage excluded from ranking and separately logged. Cold not fresh-process timing. H construction and metric factorization aggregate setup, shared full-H need.

bootstrap.resampling: Paired whole seeds across all candidates and checkpoints, both methods and refs
bootstrap.pointwise: Percentile95% metrics/time/frontier differences, recompute minima and non-dominated frontier per draw
bootstrap.simultaneous: 95% max-absolute-standardized bootstrap deviation band across all eligible config/checkpoint/reference accuracy means; conservative upper bounds require both metrics and both refs. Conditional on fixed references; finite8-seed bootstrap is approximate.

threshold_sweep.statuses: Point-estimate and simultaneous-upper-supported attainment separately. Min over frozen validated candidate grid only, not all continuous n,h or unvalidated pilot grid. Keep Not Reached mass; no finite speedup if either point method unattained.

selection_bias: Validation-grid minima and frontiers descriptive and may be optimistic; simultaneous accuracy bounds offer stronger but approximate attainment support, not global cost optimality. Bootstrap selection frequencies retained; no cherry-picked main threshold.
automatic: Preflight -> base pilot -> one bounded refinement -> freeze candidates/horizon -> independent validation -> reconstruct/check metrics -> simultaneous/pointwise frontier analysis -> plots/report/raw archive/checksums. No user decisions. No P3B.
persistence: Local atomic files, idle-sleep prevention; no active Drive sync
artifact_scope: Archive includes frozen target/scoring/quality assets, full run JSON/NPZ, protocol, source, analysis and plots.
